title: Upgrade arc rollup and campaign bible to authored content
description: Follow-up to loreweaver-e0a (PR #26). e0a wired a deliberately mechanical campaign arc rollup: gracefulClose calls rollupCampaignArc with a single campaign arc (arc-1), an arc summary joined mechanically from session recaps, and an empty campaign bible row. This issue tracks upgrading that baseline to real content: (1) model-authored arc summaries - depends on the model-backed summarization machinery built for loreweaver-32m; (2) populating the campaign bible (worldFacts/majorNpcs/factions/openThreads) from an extraction source; (3) real multi-session arc boundaries instead of the single arc-1 assumption, which needs an arc-management feature. Full design analysis is in the loreweaver-e0a comments. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
notes: Decomposed (2026-05-22): split into three child issues. 06b-A loreweaver-4ua (model-authored arc summary) — claimed this session. 06b-B loreweaver-5ze (model-extracted campaign bible) — depends on A. 06b-C loreweaver-x63 (multi-session arc boundaries) — independent, epic-sized, needs its own brainstorm. 06b stays open as parent tracker; the bd dep from 06b -> 06b-C couldn't be added (an epic can't block a non-epic in bd), but C is tracked manually as a child. 06b closes when all three children close.
close_reason: Authored-content scope complete: 06b-A loreweaver-4ua (model-authored arc summary, merged #50) and 06b-B loreweaver-5ze (model-extracted campaign bible, merged #54) both shipped on main. 06b-C loreweaver-x63 (multi-session arc boundaries) was carved off as an independent epic needing its own brainstorming pass and continues to track that work; it is not blocking this parent tracker any further.
